response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.85. A human analyst still has to record the decision.

**Three facts that drove it:**
1. T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It quotes paired 334-lot bids and offers (typical order size is 327) and re-posts them within about 10ms of each cancel. Cancel symmetry is 0.916, and the largest resting order is 0.13x average depth, so there is no large one-sided order.
2. The SELL side executed 9,724 lots (65% of what was submitted) before the single 72-lot BUY fill, and nothing after it. The BUY fill was on the trader's own resting bid. The orders were live quotes, so the "order not intended to execute" feature is absent.
3. There is no benefit from the opposite-side fill. Reversion is 0 and there were no repeat cycles in the session. The 3.3-tick round trip is ordinary spread income from a two-sided quoter.

**What would change my mind:** Evidence that the SELL quotes were one-sided and pulled right after a BUY fill, or a price move that reverted after the cancel.

The two earlier T-MM-02 closures (H-T-MM-02-01 and H-T-MM-02-02) were context only. I judged this window on its own tape.
